name: Alpha Chi Omega-Alpha Lambda Chapter #528
description: Alpha Chi Omega is an NPC sorority chartered at the University of Minnesota in September of 1921, marking over 100 years on campus. Alpha Chi supports Domestic Violence Awareness and Sexual Assault Prevention. We work directly with our local women's shelter, Alexandra House. Our five membership standards include Leadership Ability, Personal Development, Academic Interest, Character, and Responsibility! Our motto is "Together let us seek the heights."

name: Alpha Delta Phi #687
description: We are the Minnesota Chapter of Alpha Delta Phi. Since 1892, we’ve focused on fostering a spirit of inclusion and community at the U while staying true to our literary roots.

name: Alpha Epsilon Pi #831
description: Alpha Epsilon Pi is unique at the University of Minnesota as a Jewish fraternity and brotherhood. We are dedicated to developing leadership for the Jewish community, strengthening fraternal bonds, and helping brothers grow and succeed. Alpha Epsilon Pi is involved in the Greek community as an IFC fraternity, participating in Homecoming and Machy Days. We are also involved in the campus Jewish community, working with organizations like Chabad and Hillel. Our chapter hosts philanthropy events driven by the Jewish value of Tzedakah for organizations including the Gift of Life foundation.

name: Alpha Phi #379
description: Chapter Mission Statement: Alpha Phi is a membership organization dedicated to promoting sisterhood, cultivating leadership, encouraging intellectual curiosity and advocating service. Alpha Phi provides unlimited leadership opportunities, academic support, campus involvement, and most importantly, long-lasting friendships. As a lifelong commitment, Alpha Phi provides an unparalleled collegiate experience and highlights individual growth through friendship and sisterhood. name: Beta Theta Pi #486
description: Beta Theta Pi is a national fraternity founded locally at the University of Minnesota in 1889. Our mission is to build principled men for a principled life under the values of Mutual Assistance, Intellectual Growth, Trust, Integrity, and Responsible conduct.

name: Delta Kappa Epsilon #262
description: A large group of respectful and courteous gentlemen who want to be part of an organization that holds each other to the highest standard possible, in the classroom and beyond.

name: Delta Sigma Delta #4869
description: Academic Excellence: To provide a platform for dental students and professionals to enhance their educational and clinical skills, and support the advancement of dental knowledge. Brotherhood and Support: To create a strong support network among members, fostering camaraderie, professional collaboration, and lifelong relationships in the dental community. Service and Leadership: To encourage leadership and community service, both within the dental profession and in broader society. This includes supporting charitable causes, dental outreach programs, and the overall betterment of public health

name: Kappa Kappa Gamma, Chi Chapter of #589
description: Kappa Kappa Gamma is an organization of women, which seeks for every member throughout her life bonds of friendship, mutual support, opportunities for self-growth, respect for intellectual development, and an understanding of and an allegiance to positive ethical principles.

name: Phi Delta Chi #532
description: Phi Delta Chi is a fraternity that aims to provide a lifelong home for pharmacy professionals and inspires brotherhood, leadership, service and scholarship.

name: Pi Beta Phi #470
description: Pi Beta Phi is a social club part of the Fraternity and Sorority life at the University of Minnesota. We empower and help connect women during their undergraduate years. We have date parties and formals, sisterhood events, philanthropy events, and so much more!

name: Sigma Alpha Epsilon #573
description: Through friendship, scholarship, leadership, and service, SAE finds men with impeccable character and helps them achieve their full potential, letting them rise to face every challenge today and tomorrow. We accomplish this by building our members into True Gentlemen.

name: Tzedek #4870
description: The purpose of Tzedek shall be to provide a safe, welcoming environment for Jews at the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus, regardless of their political beliefs or ideologies. It shall also seek to provide assistance for like-minded groups and vulnerable members of the university community, regardless of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, gender, age, marital status, disability, public assistance status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression.

name: U Link #4507
description: U Link is a student-run, non-profit organization at the U composed of professional students positioned to support the needs of community organizations that serve vulnerable youth. Our mission is to make our organization a place where student-mentors are inspired to become leaders and advocates for change within our communities, all while providing vulnerable youth stable role-models in their sometimes unstable lives. U Link currently has chapters at the University of Minnesota - Twin Cities and the University of Minnesota - Duluth.

name: U Volunteer #4219
description: U Volunteer is an organization that brings volunteer opportunities to students at the University of Minnesota. Each month, U Volunteer offers its members various opportunities to give back to the community during meetings and group outings. U Volunteer has monthly meetings on Wednesday from 7-8pm. During these meetings, students will get together to talk about upcoming volunteer events and volunteer their time in a simple way such as making blankets for those in need or picking up trash. There will also be one "outing" each month where students will go somewhere on or near campus to volunteer

name: U-Finance #3046
description: U-Finance is a student group that is focused on providing services to other clubs through three distinct service areas - Data Analytics, Budget and Grants, and Tax. We work on client teams and solve problems for our clients. Members develop skills such as communication, presentation and technical skills.

name: U-Swing #334
description: Dancing is a fun, healthy way to meet new people, learn something new, relieve stress, and build confidence! At Uswing, our mission is to introduce you to the vibrant swing dance community in the Twin Cities and teach basic swing moves so you feel comfortable dancing socially. We provide a safe space to practice and have fun! At Uswing, we have a strong sense of community. The club is open to all University of Minnesota students and no prior dance experience is needed. We welcome any new members at any time of the year! Our meetings are from 8:30-10/10:30 PM on Thursday every week at the Barba

name: UBreak #2033
description: We breakdance! Ubreak is a club for anyone who wants to learn breakdancing or hone their skills, there is no prior experience required. Ubreak is a good place to learn a new skill, meet new people, and just have fun! Reach out over email or instagram for practice time details!
